name: SemiFantasy III: duch draka
source:
Join young peasant Duboslav on his path to become a famous adventurer! He just want to find dragons, treasures, and some love...

VN made for the [url=https://akicon.cz/souteze/renai/]Renai Reloaded[/url] competition hosted during Akicon 2023.
translation:
与年轻农民杜博斯拉夫一起踏上成为著名冒险家的道路！他只是想找到龙、宝藏和一些爱……

VN为Akicon 2023期间举办的 [url=https://akicon.cz/souteze/renai/]Renai Reloaded[/url] 比赛制作。
